description:
OUTRO ticket for fz-hwn.27. The cleanup gate -- the epic is not done until the triggers are gone.

Acceptance criteria (proposal.html):
- New machinery correct in isolation -- Step 1 unit tests pass: (a,b) != (a,a), repeated-name unification, cross-depth Underconstrained, input<->result identity.
- The conflation is gone -- no per-position alpha normalization remains; an activation key is the canonical arrow by construction.
- fz-hwn.23 falls out -- compiler2_interp_runs_enum_with_index_mapper_from_backend_artifacts is re-enabled and green for the RIGHT reason: no value-template activation reaches the backend.
- NO TRIGGER SURVIVES -- grep -rn "Trash\|trash_" src/ returns nothing. Every renamed concept is REMOVED, not merely hidden. Any trigger still standing means a caller still leans on dead code: that is unfinished body work, not an outro deferral.
- Whole-suite green, zero warnings -- lib + fixture matrix, verified from a fresh uniquely-marked run (feedback_verify_green_before_commit).

If any symbol cannot yet be removed, the blocking consumer is a NEW ticket on this epic, not a silent deferral (feedback_no_silent_deferrals).

Depends on: contract.rs collapse (fz-hwn.27.9), fz-hwn.23.
title: Remove every Trash/trash_ trigger; prove the conflation is gone and the suite is green
